what: What the Opus picker may start by itself and what waits for the owner's yes. Sources are the owner's standing rules; the picker reads this file before it writes a card.
free_to_run: CPU-only local jobs, each capped at 60 minutes, with a PID-verified stop armed at launch
Reading result files, the ledger and the playbook
A ledger prediction before the run and a score note after (kit/live/run_round.py)
Editing pages already listed in knowledge_pipeline/services.md
Local Clef for MM3 verdicts and labelling (approved in /workspace/CLAUDE.md)
needs_owner_yes: Any hosted call that costs money (spend 67.7 of 70 USD at the last count; the owner reconciles)
Making pulse_reader the default; any network exposure
A new page (rule 2026-11-08: extend a listed page instead)
Starting or stopping services that are not ours
Training on or redistributing anchor data (MN-DS, MAVEN-FACT, CheckThat are scoring-only), EXCEPT the one MN-DS grant below; redistributing any anchor data still needs a yes
card_rules: Prediction range written before the run
No human raters; truth comes from public datasets, and agreement between models is not accuracy
A weak or null result is recorded as a miss and routed, not hidden
sources: memory: feedback_local_gpu_needs_permission, feedback_kaggle_first, feedback_one_hour_cap, feedback_no_hosted_in_tests, feedback_no_human_labels, feedback_services_md_no_new_pages

owner_grants.grant: MN-DS may be used for TRAINING a small re-ranker of the landing's candidates (topic_loop.py), for this re-ranker only. Conditions: publisher split made once (specs/topic_loop_split_v1.json) with a clean, deduplicated test part never trained on; adopt only if it beats the landing on the clean part beyond chance, does not hurt live checks, and improves at least one live check. Supersedes 'MN-DS scoring only' for this re-ranker only.
owner_grants.licence: L2753: MN-DS labels CC BY 4.0 (Zenodo 7394851), attribution required; article-text terms not confirmed, check before any commercial release
owner_grants.not_covered: any other model, student or head trained on MN-DS; redistribution

owner_grants.grant: Local RTX 5090 jobs of at most 1 hour; GPU services may be stopped when a job needs the GPU (say what was stopped); Kaggle CPU or GPU allowed. No unattended job over 1 hour, kill by verified PID.

keyword_flags_note: 'mn-ds' stays a flag; a topic_loop card must assert no test-clean id or publisher in training input (topic_loop.assert_no_leak) and name L2751 in its change line
